verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents documents a broad first-party voice library (5k+ voices across 31 languages, with customization) and lets an agent switch between multiple voices. Nothing in the evidence shows a developer can plug in third-party or multiple TTS providers, so the story's second path is not covered. missing for 10: evidence of plugging in multiple or third-party TTS providers, independent or hands-on corroboration of voice library breadth and quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Select from 5k+ voices across 31 languages with customization options
Enable your agent to switch between different voices for multi-character conversations, storytelling, and language tutoring.
You can customize various aspects of your AI agent's voice to create a more natural and engaging conversation experience.
